tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')

df = u.merge(c.rename(columns={'vcpu':'cur_vcpu','memory_gib':'cur_mem','hourly_usd':'cur_hourly','family':'family'}), on='instance_type', how='left')

df['req_vcpu'] = df['cur_vcpu']*df['p95_cpu_pct']/100/0.7
df['req_mem'] = df['cur_mem']*df['p95_mem_pct']/100/0.8

# catalog by family
recs = []
for _, row in df.iterrows():
    fam = c[c['family']==row['family']]
    cand = fam[(fam['vcpu']>=row['req_vcpu']) & (fam['memory_gib']>=row['req_mem'])]
    if len(cand)==0:
        rec_type = row['instance_type']
        rec_hourly = row['cur_hourly']
    else:
        best = cand.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0]
        rec_type = best['instance_type']
        rec_hourly = best['hourly_usd']
    recs.append((row['instance_id'], row['instance_type'], rec_type, row['cur_hourly'], rec_hourly))

r = pd.DataFrame(recs, columns=['id','cur_type','rec_type','cur_h','rec_h'])
under = r[r['rec_h'] > r['cur_h']]
print(under)
print(r.head())
